description: Data Underlying the Study on Willingness to Pay and Economic Feasibility for Waste Management in Cape Maclear, Malawi is published by Abgottspon, Elena; Tilley, Elizabeth; Tkaczuk, Jakub. The field survey studies willingness to pay and economic feasibility for local waste management. Its stated coverage is Cape Maclear, Malawi; November and December 2023. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. Stated willingness to pay does not establish realised fee collection. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
